sentences.text: Everyone thinks lemmings jump off cliffs together.
The ones on camera were pushed.
In nineteen fifty-eight, a nature film crew wanted lemmings marching to their deaths.
But real lemmings don't do that, and they don't even live where the crew was filming.
So the crew bought lemmings from local kids, and ran them on a snowy spinning table to look like thousands.
Then they pushed them off a cliff into a river, and the narrator called it nature.
Walt Disney's studio. And it won an Oscar.
Schools showed it for years, and millions of kids believed it.
Should they give the award back?
